mapping.draft_py:
# Gravewaker: the compiler's own "{5}{B}{B}: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the
# battlefield." (frame B13-activated + B5b-return-creatures-battlefield) plus "tapped", which is the
# MOVE_ZONE role tapped_on_enter (Silversmote Ghoul's "... to the battlefield tapped").
reanimate = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(parts=(
        CostManaColor(color='B', amount=QConst(value=1)),
        CostManaColor(color='B', amount=QConst(value=1)),
        CostManaGeneric(amount=QConst(value=5)),
    )),
    effect=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
        'cards': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
            filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
        ),
        'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        'tapped_on_enter': True,
    }),
)
abilities = [reanimate, *compiled]
